minimal_correction.title: Continuous Segment-to-AABB Static Swept Clearance in DWA Trajectory & Braking Validation
minimal_correction.description: In evaluate_trajectory_with_braking(), evaluate segment-to-AABB static clearance along each trajectory and braking segment [prev_pose, curr_pose] (matching compute_swept_clearance_m() in analysis/metrics.py), rather than checking static obstacles only pointwise at endpoints.
minimal_correction.expected_effect: Eliminates the candidate-vs-evaluator geometric mismatch so DWA rejects any segment whose interior dips below 0.150000 m against static obstacles.
